title: OOMKilled: payment-service pod restarted 4 times in 10 minutes
root_cause: Memory leak in Stripe webhook retry handler. Unbounded list accumulating failed webhook payloads on each retry. After ~500 retries the container hit its 512Mi memory limit.
fix_applied: Rolled back deployment to v2.3.1 using `kubectl rollout undo deployment/payment-service`. Then patched the retry handler to cap the error list at 100 entries and push to a dead-letter queue instead. Redeployed v2.3.2.

title: auth-service returning 503 — DB connection pool exhausted
root_cause: pgbouncer max_client_conn was set to 20, a default from initial setup. After horizontal scaling to 8 replicas, each holding 5 idle connections, the pool was consistently exhausted under normal traffic.
fix_applied: Updated pgbouncer.ini: max_client_conn=200, pool_size=20. Restarted pgbouncer pod via `kubectl rollout restart deployment/pgbouncer`. Confirmed connection count dropped below threshold.

title: order-service pods in CrashLoopBackOff after deploy
root_cause: New deployment manifest missing envFrom secretRef for 'order-service-secrets'. The SECRET_KEY env var was absent, causing the app to panic on startup.
fix_applied: Added `envFrom: - secretRef: name: order-service-secrets` to deployment.yaml. Ran `kubectl apply -f deployment.yaml`. Pods became Ready within 90 seconds.

title: High latency on /api/checkout — p99 spiked to 8s
root_cause: N+1 query in the cart item resolver. Each cart item triggered a separate SELECT on the products table. A cart with 20 items fired 21 queries instead of 1.
fix_applied: Added `select_related('product')` to the cart queryset. Deployed hotfix. p99 dropped back to 180ms within 2 minutes of deploy.

title: Redis NOAUTH error — cache layer failing for all services
root_cause: Redis was restarted by the node maintenance script and came back with requirepass enabled (from a config template change). Services were connecting with no password as they had before.
fix_applied: Updated the REDIS_URL secret in k8s to include :password@ prefix. Rolled out config change to all 12 affected deployments using `kubectl set env`. Services recovered automatically as they reconnected.

title: Kafka consumer lag growing — notification-service not processing events
root_cause: Deserialization error on a new event schema introduced in v1.4. The consumer was silently failing and not committing offsets, causing lag to accumulate. The error was swallowed by a bare except clause.
fix_applied: Deployed v1.4.1 with schema validation and explicit dead-letter routing for malformed events. Manually reset consumer offset to skip the 3000 malformed events. Consumer lag cleared in 8 minutes.

title: Disk usage at 95% on Elasticsearch node — cluster yellow
root_cause: Log retention policy was misconfigured: indices older than 7 days should auto-delete, but the ILM policy was attached to the wrong index pattern. Logs from 3 months were accumulating.
fix_applied: Ran `DELETE /logs-*-2026.06.*` for June indices to reclaim immediate space. Fixed ILM policy to target `logs-*`. Set up Prometheus alert for disk > 80% per node.

title: inventory-service 500 errors — foreign key constraint violation
root_cause: A data migration script ran in production without transactions. It deleted product category records that inventory items referenced. ~3000 rows left in an inconsistent state.
fix_applied: Restored category records from RDS snapshot taken 2 hours prior using point-in-time recovery for just the `product_categories` table. Re-ran migration inside a transaction with proper dependency ordering.
